```json
{"ranking": ["Mq1", "Mq0", "Mq2"], "fault": "Mq1's PMOS current-starving mirror device is undersized: W=3.889 um instead of 25.92 um like Mq0, Mq2 and Mb2. That gives stage 1 a much weaker pull-up current than the other stages. At low vctrl the oscillator stalls (f_lo = n/a), so the tuning ratio fails."}
```

Mq1 is the only device that breaks the symmetry of the three stages. Every other PMOS mirror device (Mq0, Mq2 and the reference Mb2) is 25.92 um wide.

The low-vctrl failure mechanism is inferred; no operating-point data was provided to confirm it. Mq0 and Mq2 are listed second and third only because they are the same kind of device in the other stages.
